hypothesis: Cross-sectional sector strength, failed-breakdown recovery and volatility/flow contraction can select one unleveraged sector ETF for one intraday holding period, with a causal cash filter. No v45 or other admitted anchor is blended in.
selection: All factor signs and definitions frozen first; training-only normalization and thresholds. Rank by minimum 2024-2025 annualized return across 9bp/18bp/delay, then worst MDD, minimum IR, minimum standard development subperiod. Freeze top three per version before history and 2026 diagnostics.
factor_audit: Report individual factor Spearman IC on 2022-23, 2024, 2025 only; no post-audit family pruning or sign change.
native_null: Only pre-null survivors receive a separately preregistered native session-signal permutation and session-safe time-shift null; no candidate admitted without both native null and global multiple-comparison pass.
data: Existing fixed manifest-identified Alpaca IEX and historical HF sources only; no download, no cross-provider filling. Entire available 2026 is consumed diagnostic, never independent OOS or ranking input.
execution_boundary: Research only. No broker constructed, no submit/cancel, no change to Paper allocation or existing execution clocks. No automatic admission.
